nodes.text: Let $R_k(G)$ denote the minimal $m$ such that if the edges of $K_m$ are $k$-coloured then there is a monochromatic copy of $G$. Determine\[R_k(K_{s,t})\]where $K_{s,t}$ is the complete bipartite graph with $s$ vertices in one component and $t$ in the other.

#558 : [Er81c] graph theory | ramsey theory Chung and Graham [ChGr75] prove the general bounds\[(2\pi\sqrt{st})^{\frac{1}{s+t}}\left(\frac{s+t}{e^2}\right)k^{\frac{st-1}{s+t}}\leq R_k(K_{s,t})\leq (t-1)(k+k^{1/s})^s\]and determined\[R_k(K_{2,2})=(1+o(1))k^2.\]Alon, Rónyai, and Szabó [ARS99] have proved that\[R_k(K_{3,3})=(1+o(1))k^3\]and that if $s\geq (t-1)!+1$ then\[R_k(K_{s,t})\asymp k^t.\]This problem is #27 in Ramsey Theory in the graphs problem collection.
